name: human and organisational
reason: Almost nothing. Two entries touch reporting practice and one touches credential handling. Every factor that decides whether a person can be talked into an action, which is most successful intrusion, has no artefact in either repo. This is stated as the largest people gap.

L11-026.note: Reporting practice covers how to communicate a finding. Disclosure handling as a process is named only by adjacency.

L11-030.note: The scorecard reflects project hygiene, which is a weak proxy for whether a developer learns from a finding.
